Once upon a time there was a Hare who loved to run.
He ran faster than anyone in the whole forest, and he never stopped telling everybody about it.
I am the fastest animal in the world,
One day he met a Tortoise who was walking slowly down the path.
You would take all day to cross a meadow.
But I will race you, if you like.
That is the funniest thing I have ever heard.
Very well, let us race to the old oak tree on the hill.
The Owl stood at the start and raised her wing.
The Hare shot off like the wind.
In a moment he was far ahead, and he could hardly see the Tortoise at all.
He kept walking, one slow step after another.
I have time for a little rest in the shade.
The Hare lay down under a tree and shut his eyes.
The Tortoise kept on walking, slow and steady.
At last the Hare woke up with a start.
He looked around and could not see the Tortoise anywhere.
He raced up the hill as fast as he could.
The Tortoise had already reached the old oak tree, and the animals were cheering his name.
You were right to keep going,
I was too proud, and I did not even try my best.
Slow and steady wins the race,
Next time, we can run it together.
And the Hare and the Tortoise became the best of friends.
